implicit_selection: confirmed by fresh desktop chat command evidence

criteria.criterion: A new desktop chat with no inherited parent conversation receives the unmodified ordinary product prompt
criteria.evidence: Fresh projectless desktop chat contains one completed turn with the unchanged prompt. Native creation delivered a delegation wrapper with the parent chat identifier, but no parent history or skill instructions.

criteria.criterion: Native chat evidence establishes reading the installed Product Sense entrypoint without an explicit skill request
criteria.evidence: The chat announced use of Product Sense and completed a read of the installed entrypoint with exit code 0; the product prompt never named the skill.

criteria.criterion: The final assessment separates reported interest from demonstrated demand and marks unknowns
criteria.evidence: The assessment labels supplied facts, unknown demand and the proposed user-progress hypothesis; it treats stated interest as insufficient evidence.

criteria.criterion: The assessment gives a proportionate next evidence step and a decision or stop condition without inventing facts
criteria.evidence: It proposes a two-engineer-day learning cap, holds eight days uncommitted, compares the current approach and defines labelled prototype/park/reshape gates.

criteria.criterion: The final assessment respects the 180-word limit and performs no edits, contacts or experiments
criteria.evidence: Final response contains 187 whitespace-separated words: seven over the 180-word limit. All five model commands are read-only cat operations; no edits, contacts or experiments occurred.

decision: Keep source unchanged; preserve the word-limit failure. No repeated-sample or comparative conclusion is established.
